name: @duckafire/lazy-loading-js
author: duckafire
description: Simple lazy loading algorithm for websites front-end.

scripts.minify: cd ./dist;test $# -ne 0 && npx terser "LazyLoading$1.js" -o "LazyLoading$1.min.js" --compress --mangle && rm "$1" && exit 0;for file in *;do npx terser "$file" -o "${file%.js}.min.js" --compress --mangle;rm "$file";done
scripts.compile: test $# -gt 0 && dest="$1" || dest="dist";case "$dest" in "dist") dest="./dist";;"test") dest="./tests/lib";;*) echo "Invalid destine: $dest" && exit 1;;esac;test $# -lt 2 && npx tsc --outDir "$dest" && unset dest && exit 0;npx tsc --project ./tsconfig.json --outDir "$dest" "./src/LazyLoading$2.ts";unset dest
scripts.build: test $# -eq 0 && npm run compile dist && npm run minify && exit 0;npm run compile "$1" && npm run minify "$1"
scripts._help:
echo "=== HELP === 
 npm run <minify|compile|build> [Image]
 npm run <clear|help>
"
